title: CronJob batch/v1beta1 is no longer served
summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the batch/v1beta1 API version of CronJob is no longer served as of v1.25, which was released on 2022-08-23.

constraints: Keep the schedule, job template, and concurrency and history settings unchanged.
The migration guide lists no notable changes between batch/v1beta1 and batch/v1 for CronJob.

steps.title: Change the CronJob apiVersion
steps.instructions: Change the reported `apiVersion` to `batch/v1` and adjust the fields below that differ between the two versions.

steps.title: Align other CronJob declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other manifest, Helm template, and kustomize patch or target that names the old API version of CronJob, so the repository agrees.

verification.purpose: Validate the migrated manifests against the schemas of the target Kubernetes version.
Ask a cluster on the target version to accept the migrated manifest without applying it.
For a Helm chart, render it and validate the output.
